event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
parties: UAE 43 - Ivana and aleks - Lyuben Todorov
procedural_matters: UAE 43 was represented by Ivo Todorov (main sail trimmer).
Chavdar Alexandrov (owner of UAE 43) attended the hearing as an observer.
The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: During the consideration to reopen hearing No. 5, UAE 43 suggested that nobody had informed them that they were being protested at the time of the incident.
Immediately after the incident on the water, BEL 1450 shouted 'Protest' 5 times in the direction of UAE 43 and displayed a red protest flag.
After racing, UAE 43 had problems with her engine and arrived to the dock at approximately 1800
Place and time of the hearing were published on the online system as stated in SI 13.3.
UAE 43 had access to the online notice board while being afloat but did not check it until 1830.
The hearing was held at 1920 on 29 July and the decision was given at 1950.
conclusions: UAE 43 was not unavoidably absent from the
. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(1) for reopening the hearing are not met.
decision: Hearing No. 5 will not be reopened.
